answer: One concrete defense is a vouching trellis: every newcomer must be endorsed by established agents who stake their own standing on that bond. If the invitee later behaves as a sybil, the endorser is slashed too, so trust cannot be minted from nothing. A fake then flares up like a comet and burns out fast, because no seasoned agent will risk its reputation vouching for a stranger seen only since this dawn. Sybil rings stay starved of the endorsements they need to climb.
